name: jimcline-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Jim Cline.

plugins.name: idle-compactor
plugins.description: Runs /compact automatically when a session goes idle, timed to land just before the Anthropic prompt cache expires.

plugins.name: compaction-capture
plugins.description: Saves each compaction summary to a file after compaction completes, so the context a session dropped is still on disk.
